subject.title: Doubao/BytePlus model catalog: cacheRead/cacheWrite pricing set to 0, missing context caching cost

question: What vendor-backed cacheRead/cacheWrite values and cache-storage mapping should OpenClaw use for the bundled BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao model catalogs?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but pricing data and the mapping from vendor cache-hit/storage fees into OpenClaw's cacheRead/cacheWrite fields require maintainer confirmation before automation opens another competing fix.

options.title: Confirm pricing and replace the stale paths
options.body: Use current vendor pricing for both plugin manifests, then close or supersede the conflicting fork PR once a clean same-repo fix lands.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to port the old core-file fix into the current plugin manifests and tests.

options.title: Pause for billing proof
options.body: Keep this issue open without a fix PR until maintainers can verify exact cache-hit and storage pricing.

recommendation.title: Confirm pricing and replace the stale paths
recommendation.body: Use current vendor pricing for both plugin manifests, then close or supersede the conflicting fork PR once a clean same-repo fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent refactor history ties this owner to the current provider catalog and plugin-manifest boundary where the fix now belongs.
